summary: This is a routine Form 6-K report by foreign private issuer WORK Medical Technology Group LTD, disclosing a private placement that closed on August 18, 2026. The company issued 2,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.00 per share and 50,000 Class B ordinary shares at $2.50 per share, raising approximately $2,125,000 in gross proceeds for business expansion, working capital and general corporate purposes. The offering was conducted under Regulation S/Section 4(a)(2) to non-US persons without general solicitation. Post-closing, the company had 4,416,569 Class A and 51,009 Class B shares outstanding. This is a standard capital raise disclosure, not a special-situation event.
